description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) used for filtering search parameters related to claim expense types within the OrangeHRM platform. It includes properties for name, status, and ID, along with validation constants and default sorting logic.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseTypeSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO used for specifying search filters when querying claim expense types, with support for filtering by name, status, and ID, and predefined sort options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DTO with a default sort field set to 'expenseType.name'.
